info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Servicing Event History Management API
info.description: The Servicing Event History Management API enables users to update details regarding customer servicing events effectively. This API allows for modifications to the servicing event history associated with specific banking transactions, ensuring that data remains current and accurate. Ideal for financial institutions and customer service platforms, this API supports operations that enhance the customer's interaction history. Typical consumers include banking applications and back-office systems that require seamless updates to service records.
